detail.title: Alpha Smart Scale with App & Bluetooth BMI - Mercury
detail.overview: The Ant Alpha is an app-enabled bathroom scale that pairs over Bluetooth to track 12 essential body metrics, including weight, BMI and body fat, all synced automatically to a companion app on Android and iOS. Its supportive large display makes results easy to read at a glance, while a rechargeable battery means no more hunting for replacement AAAs every few months. The scale recognises individual users automatically once paired, making it simple for a whole household to track their progress on one machine without mixing up data. Finished in a striking Mercury tone, it's a practical, long-lasting addition to any bathroom or home gym.
